scope: Actual Inkscape interoperability automation; distinct from product exporter tests

attempts.observation: Actual extension changed Czech text to uppercase, but extension invocation cleared selection and the following fill action did not affect the label
attempts.correction: Explicitly reselect the stable label ID after the extension before the fill action

attempts.limitation: In headless extension mode uppercase applies to all text in the edited copy; this is not claimed as an isolated label-content edit
attempts.follow_up: Add a native GUI edit to the selected text object, save and compare all other text objects

attempts.observation: Native GUI changed the intended label and preserved Czech characters, but Unicode packet input did not retain spaces; exact-content assertion correctly failed
attempts.correction: Use a native space key for spaces; final isolated-label proof uses the unambiguous Czech word Žluťoučký
